criteria.evidence: Staff sees the queue in the «Обращения» section (registry of admin sections #23, journal §37 item 13). e2e web/tests/e2e/119-admin-support-queue.spec.ts: `admin` opens /admin/support?topic=copyright and sees the queue rows with the masked sender address t***r@example.test, no message text in the table and the unanswered counter; `owner` checks the status filter and the answered row leaves the list; `editor`, `moderator` and `analyst` receive HTTP 403 and see no table; the card under `owner` shows the full address and the message and an admin.read.personal row appears in the database with context 'support' and purpose 'admin.support.read' (journal §28.7). Domain-level permissions are covered by server/tests/admin-support.test.ts: admin and owner read the queue, the other service roles and an account get FORBIDDEN, a guest gets UNAUTHENTICATED, the list masks the address and hides the message with no audit row, the card returns both and writes the audit row.

The sender sees the status of their own request in the cabinet (journal §37 item 2). e2e of the same file: on /me the zone dashboard-support shows «Принято» for the unanswered request and «Отвечено» for the answered one, and the message text is not in the zone. server/tests/admin-support.test.ts covers the selection itself: mySupportRequests returns only rows bound to the account by userId with the derived status, other accounts' and guest requests are excluded, and a guest gets UNAUTHENTICATED.

The answer writes support.request.answered (events registry #91). server/tests/admin-support.test.ts: marking the request answered stores answeredAt and answeredById and logs support.request.answered with topic and status only — the entry carries neither the sender address nor the message; a second mark answers CONFLICT, keeps the first date and logs no second event; an unknown request answers NOT_FOUND and writes no event; `moderator` gets FORBIDDEN and no update is issued. The code was added to LOG_EVENT_CODES and is tied to the registry by the bijective test server/tests/event-code-registry.test.ts, whose filter required bringing the #91 status row to the fact.
